findings.desc: numeric-inconsistency: S17 states "~29-58 fixtures per group, both arms — roughly 84-116 paired fault-task runs total" but 2 fault-bearing groups x (29-58 fixtures each) in a matched-pairs design yields 58-116 total paired runs, not 84-116; the lower bound of 84 implies 42 fixtures per group, not 29; no arithmetic path from 29 per group to 84 total can be found
findings.resolvedReason: S17 restated coherently in commit 3d666c058: roughly 27-62 powered in-store fault fixtures, each run under both arms — i.e. ~54-124 arm-runs — plus separately sized held-out negative-control and clean fixtures. The muddled 84-116 total (which mixed a per-group count with a single-group arm-run count) is gone.

findings.desc: numeric-inconsistency: S7 planning table states reference N "~29-58 per arm" for the seeded controlled stratum (baseline 0.5-0.8, MDE 0.25-0.35), but a two-proportion z-test (alpha=0.05, power=0.80) across that full parameter band yields 25-59 per arm; the lower bound is 25, not 29 — verified by computing n at (baseline=0.5, MDE=0.35) = 25 and (baseline=0.55, MDE=0.35) = 27; only (baseline=0.5, MDE=0.33) or (baseline=0.55, MDE=0.34) yields n=29; the stated lower bound overstates required N at the most favorable parameter extreme by 14%
findings.resolvedReason: S7 reference band corrected to ~27-62 over the corners of the planning band (recomputed pooled two-proportion: min 27 at baseline 0.5/MDE 0.35, max 62; S8 usage updated to 27-62 as well). Commit 3d666c058.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: M6 milestone (Reuses column) cites "Campaign runner (run-campaign.mjs identity-keyed resume)" as an existing reusable component, but experiments/recovery-runner/run-campaign.mjs does not exist in the repo (confirmed: ls experiments/recovery-runner/*.mjs lists no such file); the autopilot-v2 reliability plan (B-4e16, INIT) describes run-campaign.mjs as a to-be-built artifact under experiments/recovery-runner/powered/; citing a planned-but-unbuilt file as a reuse target is a factual error in the plan
findings.resolvedReason: M6 Reuses now cites the committed engine (run-driver.mjs / live-engine.mjs) and explicitly marks the identity-keyed campaign-resume runner as gitignored scratch under experiments/recovery-runner/powered/ that must be committed as part of M6 (added to M6 exit criteria); M7 Reuses same-class fix for session-guard/watchdog. Verified via git ls-files (203 tracked recovery-runner files; powered/ ignored at .gitignore:86). Commit 3d666c058.

findings.desc: arithmetic-incoherent: S7 table (line 221) and S8/S17 cite ~27-62 as the corners-of-planning-band range for the unpaired two-proportion reference N, but 27 and 62 come from two different formulas. Under the standard pooled two-sided z-test (the formula labeled unpaired two-proportion in the table), the four-corner range is 27-58 (min: p=0.5/MDE=0.35 => N=27; max: p=0.5/MDE=0.25 => N=58). The value 62 only emerges from the Fleiss continuity-corrected variant at p=0.8/MDE=0.25 (N=62), but that same formula gives min=33, not 27. Mixing the uncorrected minimum with the continuity-corrected maximum produces an incoherent band. The correct uncorrected-formula range to cite is ~27-58; if continuity correction is intended, cite ~33-66 and label it as such.

[host-2 Codex P2] S11.1 primary decision rule is incomplete: H1 is supported only when the risk difference is negative — a negative point estimate is not an alpha=0.05 decision rule, and the co-primary H1a/H1b pass condition is not explicit. Fix: define support as the paired risk-difference two-sided 95% CI upper bound < 0 for BOTH H1a and H1b on the fault-bearing in-store stratum (equivalently McNemar rejects at alpha=0.05 with a negative point estimate); RR stays descriptive-only.
